title: 35 mm carrier with CS-LITE
engineering: A 40 × 28 mm CS-LITE baffle aperture reduces the modeled bright area outside the image from 80.98% to 23.93% of open area, with 1.25 mm minimum field clearance.
physical_check: Measure where the lit area actually sits in the housing. Use uncropped RAW flat-field captures to check edge-to-center exposure, color variation, shadowing and stray light for each operating mode.

title: Kodak Disc flatbed adapter
engineering: Tightening the Disc index shoe reduces modeled angular freedom from 1.65° to 0.43° and leaves 0.17 mm worst indexed frame margin.
physical_check: Measure the actual disc hub, film plane, detent or original die-cut notch geometry and frame radii on sacrificial film. Verify the follower engages the hub with clear access, does not contact sensitized image areas and leaves the actual V600 calibration path clear.

title: 127 strip flatbed adapter
engineering: Adding intermediate edge clips lowers the modeled free-edge rise from 3.82 to 0.44 mm while preserving 0.50 mm clamp-to-image clearance.
physical_check: Measure a representative range of aged 127 strip curvatures, including roller-set and cross-film curl. Verify clip retention and contact marks outside the frame, then check sharpness and Epson transparency calibration.

title: 126 strip flatbed adapter
engineering: Using a single asymmetric key gives 0.20 mm seating margin for the forward specimen and rejects the reflected single-perforation position.
physical_check: Measure the actual 126 strip’s perforation and its frame offset. Use a soft retractable pin, verify registration without forcing or stretching the perforation, and inspect edge crops and host calibration.

title: 120 flatbed holder for Epson V600
engineering: The three-height shim coupon spans 0.50 mm and offers 0.17 mm worst-case reserve within a hypothetical focus band.
physical_check: Measure glass-to-emulsion offsets with the real V600, fit the shims without blocking factory holder markers, and compare center and corner target sharpness at every height and both curl orientations.

title: 110 holder for Epson 4870
engineering: Four windows on 19 mm pitch leave 0.375 mm worst crop registration margin and 0.85 mm of opaque land between crops.
physical_check: Confirm the 4870 transparency unit and software with a manual marquee, then measure the top clear calibration zone, actual film pitch, both edge support lines and the minimum focus stand-off. Check retained frames for scratches and corner falloff.

title: 8 mm film inspection holder
engineering: An offset 3.67 × 5.22 mm still window preserves 0.059 mm minimum image margin through the modeled pose sweep and excludes the neighboring images and perforation side.
physical_check: Verify Standard 8 on examples of the actual archived stock, perforation side and picture orientation. Check print scale and use a measurable alignment ruler to test real still-frame inspection. Inspect abrasions and compare optical resolution with a camera-copy setup.
